name: Adwa Victory Memorial
subtitle: A memorial and museum complex in central Addis Ababa marking the Battle of Adwa, inaugurated in February 2024.

facts.label: Inaugurated
facts.value: 11 February 2024 by PM Abiy Ahmed and President Sahlework Zewde

facts.label: Gates
facts.value: Eight gates dedicated to Ethiopian forefathers

facts.label: Museum highlight
facts.value: A detailed sandcast of the Battle of Adwa; the first aircraft built in Ethiopia

parts.text: A memorial and museum complex in central Addis Ababa marking the Battle of Adwa, inaugurated in February 2024. It combines gates, statues and a museum.
